page.notes: The woodcut shows a sun, moon and earth with rays forming an eclipse within a circle; it is not transcribed as text. Top line reads "obscurationem sentiunt, sed uel partem eripi ex-" with hyphen at line end; the text has been transcribed with its long s rendered as s. Words such as "Eclipsin" and "uniuersalem" are printed with long s and were normalised. The signature "Magni" is printed at the right margin, with a trailing hyphen-like mark. Some letters in the top lines are damaged by the scan, notably "Hinc" and "Solis totalem", which are read with reasonable confidence.
